I am looking for a designer / designerly HRI scholar or a researcher on participatory design/co-design to join my team for a 3-year PostDoc position.

The position is part of a career grant by VolkswagenStiftung to develop my chair into the direction of designing and building low-cost robots ourselves. The person I am looking for should therefore have a background in design and should bring this design perspective into the team, our research and teaching.

It is a really nice position since we are completely free as to what kind of robots we want to build. However, they should be diy, low-cost.

You are responsible for launching (co-)design projects (with money for consumables, a student assistant, a technician and a little FabLab in your back) together with other team members and students. Let your imagination run wild in how to design meaningful robots for people.

At the end of the three years we want to launch a huge long-term field study with the robot(s) we have developed.

The position is available as soon as possible.

It is a 3-year full-time position (part time possible).

The salary is based on the German public service salary scale (TV-L). The position corresponds to a pay grade of EG 13 TV-L.
